messages:
alex: perf-bot popped a regression on the continuous-batcher canary, p99 latency +42% at qps=120. Link: https://ci/reports/321
perf-bot: [AUTO] Regression detected for model redwood-7B-v2 on pool batch-a
maria: saw same, but only when kernel_selector enabled? I have profile attached.
sam: short log: kv_cache_hit=0.78 -> 0.71, decode_kernel=fallback_fp16_int8, p99_decode_ms=180 -> 240
kevin: hmm, sounds like KV prefetch budget got lowered by new token_budget targets. Who changed admission policy?
maria: that was my change in the adaptive-token-budgets PR; I lowered per-request token_budget for mid-length cohort from 64 -> 48
alex: can you paste the config we rolled?
maria: here's the snippet:
```json
{"admission_policy":{"buckets":[{"max_len":64,"token_budget":48,"decode_rate_target":1.2},{"max_len":256,"token_budget":96,"decode_rate_target":1.0}],"kernel_map":{"slow_decode":"fp16_int8","fast_decode":"amp_kv"}}}
```
sam: interesting — kernel_map fallback to fp16_int8 increases per-token decode cost by ~25% on those prompts
kevin: propose: temporarily bump token_budget for len<128 to 72 and enable prefetch_kv=true for that cohort. Also add a decode_rate bucket for "burst" flows.
maria: +1. I'll push a patch to canary and re-run the profiler
alex: also add a sampling flag to log kernel decisions + kv hit sample per-request
perf-bot: [AUTO] New canary build scheduled: canary/1742503300
sam: after the tweak p99 dropped back ~12% but KV hit still ~-3%, need deeper trace
kevin: can we run a microprofiling pass with per-layer timing? Use `--profiler=layers --trace-mode=sampled` on canary
maria: doing it now, will post results in ~30m
alex: cool, please annotate any requests that hit fp16_int8 kernel
sam: right, focus on decode_rate buckets: our classifier currently uses avg_decode_tokens_per_sec, maybe it's noisy for small prompts
maria: thinking of smoothing with EMA window=10 and a min_samples=5
kevin: ok let's track: 1) revert token_budget for <128 to 72 2) enable kv_prefetch 3) add kernel decision logging 4) run layer profiler 5) re-evaluate steady-state qps
alex: +1
maria: patch up in #3127, will canary in 10m
perf-bot: [AUTO] Canary deployed 1742503330
sam: thx, monitoring p50/p95/p99 now
alex: thanks team, this feels like a mix of kernel selection threshold + token budget that made KV prefetching ineffective; good catch
kevin: file a short postmortem if canary confirms; include perf graphs and config diffs
maria: will do
